messages:
maria (infra): Heads up — after the base-gpu image roll last night (~base-gpu:2026-03-17) a subset of eu-west-2 GPU nodes started failing pods with runtime errors about missing libcuda/libnvidia-ml. Noticed ~18 nodes out of 110 impacted.

deploy-bot: rolled base-gpu:2026-03-17 to eu-west-2 at 02:31 UTC :white_check_mark:

aj (eng-runtime): ugh. any quick logs?

maria (infra): paste from a failing pod describe ->
```
Events:
  Warning  FailedCreatePodSandBox  3s (x4 over 2m)  kubelet, gpu-node-42  Failed to create pod sandbox: rpc error: code = NotFound desc = could not find host lib: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.1: no such file or directory
```

chen (eng-runtime): that path mismatch smells like the toolkit changed where it expects host driver libs to be mounted. Which nvidia-container-toolkit version is in the new image?

maria (infra): new base includes nvidia-container-toolkit v1.12.0 (we had v1.10.3 previously). Driver package on nodes is nvidia-driver-535. eu-west-2 nodes are on kernel 6.1.0-custom.

ben (sre): are these only in eu-west-2?

maria (infra): yes — staging and us-west are fine. eu-west-2 is the only region with the custom kernel line and a recent host-driver rebuild.

tanya (oncall): we're also seeing application-level startup errors: NCCL init failures and CUDA device not found on some jobs. Might be the same missing symlink so containers can't access /dev/nvidia* or libs.

aj (eng-runtime): theory: toolkit v1.12 switched to using the host bind path under /run/nvidia/driver and new nodes have drivers installed under /run. Old expectation was /usr/lib. If the runtime shim doesn't create the compatibility symlinks, container runtime fails.

maria (infra): confirmed on one node: driver libs exist at /run/nvidia/driver/lib/libcuda.so.1 but /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.1 is absent.

chen (eng-runtime): quick mitigation: we can push a DaemonSet initContainer that, on startup, creates compatibility symlinks from /run/nvidia/driver/lib -> /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu and also ensures /run/nvidia is mounted into runtime plugin. Patch ready: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/542 (hotfix)

ben (sre): can we instead roll the base image back? Rolling forward-hotfix vs rollback tradeoff? Rollback minimizes operational complexity but loses toolkit upgrade.

maria (infra): rollback ETA ~30m if approved (image promotation + drain/cordon). Hotfix deploy (daemonset) can be <=10m but touches node filesystems and needs careful validation.

aj (eng-runtime): also: we should guard against driver+kernel combos we haven't validated. Suggest adding a kubelet preflight check that looks for at least one of the expected lib paths before accepting new base image/driver combos. I'll open a follow-up.

tanya (oncall): SLO impact: small batch inference jobs are failing intermittently in eu-west-2. Alert volume up ~7% last hour. Can we prioritize rollback to reduce customer impact?

maria (infra): rolling back now to base-gpu:2026-03-10 (previous stable). Starting image promotion and will cordon/evict in small batches, will post progress.

infra-bot: image-promotion job started for base-gpu:2026-03-10 -> eu-west-2 at 03:12 UTC

aj (eng-runtime): while rollback proceeds, deploying the initContainer daemonset to cover any stragglers is low-risk — it just creates symlinks and logs, noop if libs already present. PR linked above.

chen (eng-runtime): note for postmortem: verify toolkit change logs — v1.12 added "host driver relocation" behavior and requires explicit host mount points in our runtime config. Also check NCCL ABI mismatch warnings when driver path absent.

ben (sre): action items captured: rollback live (maria), daemonset hotfix (aj/chen), preflight check PR (aj), compatibility matrix run (maria + eng-runtime). I'll create the incident ticket and assign.

maria (infra): rollback finished for first 40 nodes, pods slowly recovering. I'll keep draining in waves. Will open postmortem stub.

tanya (oncall): thanks. Keep alerts muted while we sweep to avoid noisy paging :pray:

maria (infra): postmortem stub: https://tribe.internal/incidents/2026-03-17-gpu-lib-mounts. Will add timeline and RCA after we complete verification.

aj (eng-runtime): quick note: add kernel version check to our fleet inventory scripts — driver relocation differences show up on 6.1+ kernels in our builds.

maria (infra): confirmed — will include kernel check in the preflight.

deploy-bot: base-gpu rollback to 2026-03-10 completed in eu-west-2 at 03:45 UTC :white_check_mark:

maria (infra): final: customers mostly recovered, continuing validation for next 2 hours. Follow-ups scheduled for tomorrow to run compatibility matrix and update release playbook. :calendar:

ben (sre): created incident: INC-2026-324, added owners, linking postmortem.

maria (infra): thanks team, we'll debrief tomorrow AM. :coffee:
